input_rule: Reuse all four fixed 1-MiB external D regions per species, no outcome selection. Same sequences; short identifiers are mapped explicitly.
fixed_D: F probabilities and old frozen threshold from 12696615; no model or calibration change
fixed_rm_library: Dfam3.9 lineage ancestors+descendants, curated and uncurated; retain empty lineage as BLOCKED_NO_LIBRARY, no surrogate taxon
interpretation: De novo discovery on 4 MiB may lack repeats/copy diversity. This is neither a whole-genome benchmark nor a method ranking; no absolute precision/F1. T2 concordance is not truth.
status_denominator: All 9 native cells plus 3 completed D cells retained. Failure and timeout do not become zero scores.
